careers.description: Special Education Teacher? A Special Education Teacher designs and delivers individualised learning experiences for students with physical, cognitive, emotional, or developmental disabilities — including autism spectrum disorder, dyslexia, intellectual disability, ADHD, hearing or visual impairment, and cerebral palsy. They sit at the intersection of pedagogy, psychology, and therapeutic support, working within mainstream schools, special schools, early intervention centres, and NGOs. In India, the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act 2016 and the National Education Policy 2020 both mandate inclusive education, creating a legally enforceable and rapidly growing demand for trained, RCI-registered special educators across every state.

careers.description: Curriculum Designer? A Curriculum Designer builds the blueprint of learning — determining what students should know, in what order, through what experiences, and measured by what outcomes.
